The main takeaway from our work is that

the effects of short chains on the overall structure and dynamics of ring and linear melts are qualitatively very similar, and the effects can be quantitatively well characterized by a simple Rouse model.

the short branches can significantly influence the structure and relaxation dynamics of the unentanglement ring and linear melt system, and that the effects of short chains on the structural and dynamical properties for the SCB melt system are very similar between ring and linear polymers.

the structural and dynamical properties, including the conformational and torsional modes, of the unentagled SCB ring and SCB linear melts can be reasonably well described with the Rouse theory, regardless of the ring topology and the existence of short branches.
